name: even-better-toml

works: Syntax and duplicate key diagnostics while typing
Format Document with the evenBetterToml.formatter settings
Go to Symbol in Editor, rename of a key, folding and semantic highlighting
Completion, hover and links from a schema set by a #:schema comment or evenBetterToml.schema.associations
TOML: Select Schema, Copy as JSON, Copy as TOML, Paste as JSON and Paste as TOML

readme:
# Even Better TOML

TOML support from the taplo language server: diagnostics, formatting, symbols, and completion and hover from JSON schemas. The server is bundled, nothing else to install.

This is the unmodified extension published on Open VSX, pinned to a specific version and verified to work in Diode.
